header.name: mc-test-lib damage-threshold probes
header.description: In-engine probes for three unobserved rulings: applyDamage on an entity with no health component, the killing-hit boundary at effectiveMin, and what the engine does when an after-event handler throws mid-cascade. Run /mctest4:nohealth, /mctest4:threshold and /mctest4:handlers (or the /scriptevent equivalents) and copy the [mctest] lines from chat or the content log.
